name: Revilla Vallejera (Spain)
description: Square green flag with a red stripe in the upper part, a white stripe through the centre and a blue stripe in the lower part, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Revilla Vallejera (a saltire on white, a saint, a tree and waves).
history: Municipal flag of Revilla Vallejera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Revilla Vallejera arms — saltire, saint, tree and waves
